identity.direction: Calm operational clarity with restrained healthcare-adjacent visual language.

responsive.mobile: Drawer navigation, one-column content, no horizontal page overflow.
responsive.desktop: Persistent navigation and full operational density.

semantic_states.loading: Contextual skeleton or spinner without replacing the shell.
semantic_states.empty: Explain true empty versus filtered empty.
semantic_states.error: Problem-oriented message with retry when appropriate.
semantic_states.offline: Persistent connectivity feedback and safe retry.
semantic_states.validation: Inline field feedback plus summary when useful.
semantic_states.conflict: Explain 409 conflict without pretending the mutation succeeded.
semantic_states.rate_limit: Explain 429 and retry timing when available.

brownfield_notes: Preserve useful existing visual identity unless a documented TO-BE decision changes it.
